مُزَقَّقٌ A ram skinned from his head to his hind leg; (Lh, TA;) as also ↓ مَزْقُوقٌ : (Lh, K, TA:) contr. of مُرَجَّلٌ (TA) and of مَرْجُولٌ. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- And A skin of which the hair is clipped, not cut off. (K, TA.) ―
-b3- And hence, as being like such a skin, (assumed tropical:) A head of which all the hair is cut off. (K, * TA.) And (assumed tropical:) A man having all the hair of his head cut off. (TA.) ―
-b4- مُزَقَّقَةٌ A large she-camel: (Ibn-'Abbád, K:) or a she-camel whose skin is filled with fat after her fleshiness. (En-Nadr, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
